AAMA.submitIntro: **{{name}}** is certified nationally through AAMA, not New York State. No Form 1 or notarization needed — TEF can pay your exam fee for eligible participants.

NYSED.submitIntro: Have your scanned, notarized Form 1 ready — you'll upload it inside the licensure fee request.

OASAS.submitIntro:
CASAC is regulated by OASAS, not NYSED, which means you do not need to submit Form 1 or get anything notarized. Simply submit the combined intake form below. After you submit, TEF emails you a confirmation letter to upload with your OASAS licensure and exam fee application.

This one form covers both licensure and exam fees. You will indicate which you're requesting reimbursement for on the form.
